messages:
sanjay: Heads up — after the Okta mapping change at ~09:12 UTC a bunch of logins drop to 'guest' via JIT because the `teams`/`tenant_id` SAML attribute is missing. Users report no access to internal dashboards. Anyone seeing this?
maya: yep, seeing ~7 affected in prod. errors in auth-service: `400 role_assignment: missing required claim tenant_id`. Pager alerts fired for the dashboards route.
chris: looks like the new attribute whitelist we pushed to Okta strips `tenant_id` when group mapping fails. repro locally with a SAML assertion that lacks the claim.
sanjay: hmm — who approved the Okta attribute policy change? @amelia?
amelia: that was a change from the IdP team to reduce attribute noise. I approved a small whitelist but I didn't realize it would drop `tenant_id` when group resolution failed. my bad. :grimacing:
idp-bot: Okta config deploy succeeded at 2026-03-20T09:12:03Z by amelia (change-id: CHG-7821).
maya: temporary mitigation: auth-service can fallback to email-domain -> org lookup if tenant_id is missing. I'm going to flip that fallback on for prod for 15m to stop user outages.
chris: +1. Also add a short-circuit that prevents creating a 'guest' with zero roles; instead create a blocked login and surface a clearer error so SRE can route users.
sanjay: please also capture audit logs. security needs the SAML assertions for affected users and the role_assignment responses. @security-oncall can you grab KMS-wrapped certs if needed for decrypting assertion payloads?
security-oncall: on it. I can pull SAML logs from the auth proxy and the Okta system log. For encrypted assertions we need the service cert from vault; requesting access via KMS path `projects/redwood/secrets/auth-service-cert` now.
amelia: rolling back the attribute whitelist change now — re-enabling `tenant_id` and `teams` in the mapping. will target rollback at 09:30 UTC.
deploy-bot: Okta config rollback job started (job: RBK-090). will post result.
maya: after I toggle fallback in auth-service I'll notify. Patch is small, will go via hotfix: `git rev hotfix/fallback-tenant-domain`.
chris: remember to increment audit event version for role assignment so we can trace which code path created the guest accounts. Add `role_source: jit_whitelist` or `role_source: domain_fallback` to events.
security-oncall: got the logs for the ten affected users and the `400 missing required claim` traces. saving to /audit/incidents/2051234567/saml-assertions-clip.txt and uploading to the incident ticket.
amelia: rollback completed at 09:31 UTC, Okta reports config state restored. idp-bot confirms. change-id RBK-090.
deploy-bot: Okta config rollback finished: success.
maya: auth fallback is live. I turned it on at 09:35 UTC and throttled to 10r/s to avoid noisy traffic.
sanjay: good. let's run a quick smoke: can the original 7 users log in and see dashboards now?
maya: confirmed 6/7 recovered, one still failing due to stale local session — asking them to clear and retry.
chris: follow-up action items: 1) add defensive code so missing tenant_id doesn't auto-assign minimal privileges, 2) add unit test for SAML assertion variants, 3) update runbook to include Okta whitelist rollback steps, 4) open a postmortem if any users lost data access >30m.
security-oncall: filing incident INC-2051234567, tagging for vuln triage if we find any L0 auth bypass. currently looks like config/rollout error rather than exploit.
sanjay: thanks all. amelia — please coordinate with IdP team to add an integration test for the mapping change before future deploys. mark this change as high-risk in the change board.
amelia: will do. apologies everyone.
chris: small config snippet we patched in auth-service for quick fallback:

```yaml
saml:
  claim_fallbacks:
    tenant_id: "email_domain"
    teams: []
  dont_create_guest_without_roles: true
```

chris: will open PR with that & tests.
security-oncall: closing loop here, if anything else pops up ping #incidents.
